question: A sum of money is put on compound interest for 2 years at 20%. It would fetch ₹964 more if the interest was payable half-yearly than if it was payable yearly. Find the sum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**According to question,

CI of half yearly - CI of yearly = Rs. 964

⇒ P[(1 + (10)/(100))⁴ - 1] - P[(1 + (20)/(100))² - 1] = 964

⇒ P[((11)/(10))⁴ - 1] - P[((6)/(5))² - 1] = 964
